senses.gloss: m. = h. סַפְסָר, accountant, a middleman, broker.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 42b:9">B. Mets. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ דזבין וכ׳</he> middleman who buys here and sells there (immediately).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:5">Ib. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>והא בעי למיתב זוזי לס׳</he> but would he not have had to pay the broker?, i.e. has he not the advantage of saving the broker’s fee?
